name: Turkish Core
orderingNote: Dictionary forms (verbs in the -mek / -mak infinitive, nouns in the nominative). Ordered by a blend of subtitle and web frequency, lemmatised with a rule-based analyser; names, vulgar words and inflected forms removed. The first 281 cards are the original hand-written Turkish deck; cards 5,001-10000 continue the same frequency order with less common words (dictionary headwords only, no proper nouns).
